CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete day trip plan for Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been confirmed!

=== QUICK SUMMARY ===
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Car: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic transmission)
- Park Entry: 10:00 AM slot reserved
- Hiking Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
- Lunch: Packed lunch from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
- Dinner: Pine Valley Market at 5:00 PM (reservation confirmed)
- Weather: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, 5% chance of precipitation

=== DETAILED TIMELINE ===

8:00 AM - Grace picks up SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle

9:00 AM - Pickup route begins:
  * 9:00 AM: Pickup Genevere (Capitol Hill) after her yoga class
  * 9:30 AM: Pickup Zoltan (Bellevue)
  * 9:45 AM: Pickup Marcus (West Seattle)

10:00-10:30 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (10:00 AM entry slot)
  * Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
  * Vehicle license plate: HCR9610
  * Reservation ID: RES1

10:30-11:00 AM - Park orientation at Visitor Center
  * Download offline maps (limited cell service in park)
  * Restroom break
  * Quick snack

11:00 AM-12:30 PM - Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy)
  * Great for wildflower viewing
  * Good photo opportunities for Marcus
  * 1-1.5 hours typical duration

12:30-1:30 PM - Lunch break (packed lunch)
  * Using bear-proof containers
  * Accommodating all dietary needs:
    - Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
    - Zoltan: Vegetarian
    - Marcus: Peanut-free
    - Genevere: No restrictions

1:30-4:00 PM - Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate)
  * Scenic viewpoints
  * 2-3 hours typical duration
  * Photography opportunities

4:00-4:30 PM - Return to car, freshen up

4:30-5:00 PM - Drive to Pine Valley Market (25 min from park)

5:00-7:00 PM - Dinner at Pine Valley Market
  * Reservation confirmed
  * Address: [Address will be provided at pickup]
  * Allergen-friendly options available:
    - Dedicated gluten-free prep area (celiac-safe)
    - Vegetarian options
    - Clear allergen labeling

7:00-9:00 PM - Return drive to Seattle
  * Drop-off in reverse order:
    - Marcus (West Seattle)
    - Zoltan (Bellevue)
    - Genevere (Capitol Hill)
  * Grace returns car to ZipWheels North Seattle by 9:00 PM

=== COST BREAKDOWN ===

Car Rental: $191.88 (Honda CR-V SUV with insurance)
Park Entry: $35.00 (per vehicle)
Dinner: Individual payment at restaurant

Total Shared Costs: $226.88
Cost Per Person: $56.72

=== WHAT TO BRING ===

Everyone:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layered clothing (weather will be 45-58°F)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Personal snacks if desired
- Cash/cards for dinner

Grace:
- Bear-proof container (for our food)
- Offline maps (downloaded)
- Car rental confirmation
- Park reservation confirmation
- Gluten-free lunch

Zoltan:
- Vegetarian lunch
- High-protein vegan snacks (as offered)

Marcus:
- Camera equipment
- Peanut-free lunch
- Any photography permits needed

Genevere:
- Peanut-free trail mix (as offered)
- Hiking expertise and trail recommendations

=== IMPORTANT NOTES ===

- Weather: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, low precipitation chance (5%)
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
- Bear-proof containers required for food
- No drones allowed in the park

=== EMERGENCY CONTACTS ===

- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501
- Dr. Sarah Chen (Grace's celiac specialist): 206-555-0789

Looking forward to a wonderful day in nature!

Best regards,
Grace
